page_title: SWI 0-0 COL (PEN: 4-3) | Switzerland v Colombia 07/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 121' This is yet another match that has been decided by a dramatic penalty shootout.
121' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) steps up to take the penalty and leaves the keeper helpless with a low shot inside the left post.
121' Goal! Luis Diaz (Colombia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gregor Kobel into the bottom left corner.
121' Goal! Cedric Itten (Switzerland) takes just a short run up and buries the penalty into the middle of the goal.

121' Cucho Hernandez (Colombia) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Gregor Kobel to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
121' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands.
121' Goal! Gregor Kobel gets a hand on the penalty from Jaminton Campaz (Colombia), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
121' Goal! Zeki Amdouni (Switzerland) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Camilo Vargas into the bottom right corner.
121' Davinson Sanchez (Colombia) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
121' GOAL! Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) sends the penalty kick into the left of the net.
121' GOAL! Juan Quintero (Colombia) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Gregor Kobel in goal.
121' The lottery of the penalty shootout is about to begin.
120+1' Ivan Barton blows his whistle and ends extra time of today's match. The penalty shoot-out will determine the winner.
120' We will have 1 min. of added time.
119' Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) is being substituted because of an injury. Nestor Lorenzo sends Yerry Mina on the pitch.
118' Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
117' Juan Quintero (Colombia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
115' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
114' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Granit Xhaka (Switzerland), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
112' My Gran could have done better! Juan Quintero (Colombia) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
111' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
109' The Switzerland players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
106' The players must be exhausted and nobody wants the penalty shoot-out. Let's see what second part of extra time can bring. It starts right now!
105+2' Ivan Barton blows for the end of the first period of extra time.
105+1' The resulting corner from Juan Quintero (Colombia) is cleared.
105+1' A pass lands at the feet of Luis Diaz (Colombia) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Colombia earn a corner.
105' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
105' Miro Muheim (Switzerland) has tested the patience of referee Ivan Barton and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
104' Zeki Amdouni (Switzerland) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Camilo Vargas.
103' It is time for a substitution. Zeki Amdouni (Switzerland) is on for Fabian Rieder.
102' Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) commits a foul and Ivan Barton immediately signals a free kick.
102' The ball is out of play and Colombia manage to earn a corner.

101' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Gregor Kobel!
100' Richard Rios (Colombia) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
99' CHANCE! Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
98' The ball goes out of play. Colombia are awarded a corner kick.
98' Luis Diaz (Colombia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
98' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
95' Davinson Sanchez (Colombia) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
93' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
92' Ivan Barton blows his whistle after Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
91' The first period of extra-time has just begun.
90+6' The second half has finished, but the result of this match is still yet to be decided.
90+4' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+3' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Switzerland win a corner kick.
90+2' Murat Yakin has decided to substitute Dan Ndoye and he is replaced by Ruben Vargas (Switzerland).
90+1' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

86' Davinson Sanchez (Colombia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' Juan Quintero (Colombia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
84' The resulting corner from Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
83' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Switzerland are going to take it.
82' Nestor Lorenzo decides to make a substitution. Jefferson Lerma will be replaced by Richard Rios (Colombia).
82' Substitution. Luis Suarez will be replaced by Cucho Hernandez (Colombia).

75' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) is flagged for offside.
74' Camilo Vargas (Colombia) is moving okay again after that injury scare. Breel Embolo (Switzerland) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' Camilo Vargas (Colombia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

60' Luis Diaz (Colombia) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gregor Kobel makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
59' Ivan Barton shows a yellow card to Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) for his blatant foul.
57' Switzerland enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
52' Davinson Sanchez (Colombia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Switzerland earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) was quite harsh and Ivan Barton didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' James Rodriguez (Colombia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
49' PENALTY APPEAL after Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

48' Ambitious effort from Djibril Sow (Switzerland). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
46' Murat Yakin has made a change at the break. Djibril Sow (Switzerland) has come on in place of Ardon Jashari.

42' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
40' Colombia take a short corner kick.
39' A cross into the box from Daniel Munoz (Colombia) is cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Colombia.
36' Daniel Munoz (Colombia) is caught offside!
35' Jhon Arias (Colombia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Luis Diaz (Colombia) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
33' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Camilo Vargas easily makes the save.
30' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
28' Ivan Barton blows for a foul after Jefferson Lerma (Colombia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
27' The Switzerland players are exchanging some short passes.
23' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
22' James Rodriguez (Colombia) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

21' Gustavo Puerta (Colombia) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Gregor Kobel, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Colombia force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Colombia.
15' A dangerous looking corner kick from Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) is cleared to safety by the defence.

14' A lofted cross from Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Switzerland.
14' The resulting free kick from James Rodriguez (Colombia) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
13' Ivan Barton blows his whistle. Nico Elvedi (Switzerland) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Colombia.

6' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' The resulting corner, taken by James Rodriguez (Colombia), comes to nothing.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jhon Arias (Colombia). Corner kick. Colombia will have an opportunity.
